thread:
hiya (newhire): hey team :wave: quick onboarding hiccup — my offer said benefits effective on start date (03/15) but benefits portal shows 04/01. also my direct deposit is pending verification and i submitted my W-4 as married but payroll preview still shows single. i'm worried about the 03/17 pay and the holiday on 03/18. who do i ping to make sure i'm covered and get deposits to my bank?

claire (people-ops): welcome! :tada: sorry for the friction. can you confirm where you uploaded docs (benefits portal or emailed benefits@redwood.com) and the last4 of your bank?

hiya (newhire): uploaded spouse docs and enrollment screenshot to the portal (file: hiya_spouse_03-12.pdf). bank last4 is 2200. forwarded enrollment confirmation to benefits@redwood.com too.

people-ops-bot: payroll-run:2026-03-16 20:00 UTC — payroll export completed. cutoff for changes was 2026-03-16 16:00 UTC. any submissions after cutoff apply to next run.

dlmitri (payroll): hi hiya  thanks for the details. micro-deposits usually take 24-48 hrs; if they don't clear by cutoff we'll default to paycard for that cycle. W-4 changes need form resubmission via https://payroll.redwood.com/forms/w4-change to queue corrections; reply here after you submit and i'll add a correction request.

olivia (benefits): hey hiya  carriers sometimes set effective dates to the 1st of the next month. i see your portal enrollment but the broker's feed stamped 04/01. i've opened ticket BEN-4720 to ask about backdating to 03/15 for your case. ETA 48 hrs. if broker can backdate we can request payroll retro-adjustment for deductions.

claire (people-ops): to protect holiday pay on 03/18, we can mark your employment record active for payroll eligibility even if the carrier uses 04/01 for medical deductions. benefits still needs to confirm carrier rules for claims coverage.

hiya (newhire): ok submitted W-4 change (form id W4-216345). i also uploaded a voided check as voided_hi2200.png.

people-ops-bot: ticket BEN-4720 updated: broker acknowledged, investigating carrier backdate policy. ETA 2026-03-18 14:30 UTC.

dlmitri (payroll): got the W-4 and voided check, thanks. i've queued direct deposit verification and the W-4 correction. if broker backdates we can run a retro adjustment; if not, we'll process an off-cycle correction on request. i'll update when bank confirms micro-deposits.

olivia (benefits): broker responded: "carrier policy: effective date = first of month after enrollment unless pre-approved exception." we requested exception and noted the holiday/start-date concern. they said 48-72 hrs. ticket assigned high priority.

claire (people-ops): short checklist for you: 1) monitor micro-deposits and reply here when they appear, 2) if holiday pay or medical deductions look off on paystub, ping payroll immediately so we can raise off-cycle, 3) we'll follow up on broker ticket and loop you in.

hiya (newhire): thanks everyone. one last ask  my commuter benefit was selected but no deduction yet — is that part of the same feed?

olivia (benefits): commuter deductions are separate but flow through the same broker. if your enrollment shows "active" in portal and broker feed hasn't run, it will hit next payroll. we'll confirm in BEN-4720 whether commuter can be prioritized.

people-ops-bot: payroll-run:2026-03-17 20:00 UTC — next export scheduled.

dlmitri (payroll): bank confirmed micro-deposits to last4 2200. direct deposit active for next run. if anything still missing after payroll posts, ping here and i'll bundle correction requests for W-4/deductions.

claire (people-ops): welcome again and sorry for the onboarding admin scramble. we'll keep this thread updated until everything is green :sparkles:
